description: This file defines constants, function prototypes, and conditional includes related to CAN bus hardware interface, primarily for automotive applications. It includes interface functions for initializing CAN, sending messages, and setting CAN parameters, along with specific CAN IDs for different vehicle models.

methods.name: commonTxInit
methods.description: Performs common initialization of CAN transmission with a specified extended ID.

methods.name: setCanType
methods.description: Sets the type of CAN communication mode.

methods.name: setTxBit
methods.description: Configures transmission bit timing or offset.
